newsitem.title: UK: UK to put more pressure on pension firms - Blair.
newsitem.headline: UK to put more pressure on pension firms - Blair.

text.p: The government has received "disappointing" replies from 24 insurance companies on their progress in compensating customers for pensions mis- selling, Prime Minister Tony Blair said on Wednesday.
"We want to put further pressure on them to deal with this problem," Blair told MPs at Prime Minister's question time.
Treasury minister Helen Liddell was due to give details later on Wednesday of the replies she had received from the companies.

Liddell, who two weeks ago named two insurance companies she said had failed to understand the government's determination for a quick resolution, is to publish a "league table" showing how the companies are responding to the issue. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
